prp.objective: Fix BUG-008: in src/tools/audit.ts renderAuditReport, make the trailing `Suggestion:` line role-aware by branching on rows[0].role — toolResult keeps the byte-identical `...result is the largest contributor. Consider mulligan_shrink.`; assistant emits `...the assistant turn \`<label>\` is the largest contributor. Consider mulligan_rewind (last_tool_call_group) or mulligan_shrink.`; any other role (user/custom/unknown) emits an honest `...the largest contributor is the \`<label>\` message (role: \`<role>\`); no Mulligan operation applies to a non-tool message.`. The empty-filtered-view branch still OMITS the Suggestion (unchanged), trailing newline behavior is identical, and renderAuditReport NEVER throws. Add test/tools/audit.test.ts cases for toolResult/assistant/user(+custom) each rendering the matching Suggestion substring, plus an empty-filtered regression. Keep the full vitest suite green.
implementationSteps: Edit 1 — src/tools/audit.ts renderAuditReport Suggestion block (lines 474–479): replace the single hard-coded `lines.push(`Suggestion: the \`${rows[0].label}\` result is the largest contributor. Consider mulligan_shrink.``)` with a branch on `rows[0].role`. Destructure `const { role, label } = rows[0];` then: if `role === "toolResult"` push ``Suggestion: the `${label}` result is the largest contributor. Consider mulligan_shrink.`` (BYTE-IDENTICAL to the current line); else if `role === "assistant"` push ``Suggestion: the assistant turn `${label}` is the largest contributor. Consider mulligan_rewind (last_tool_call_group) or mulligan_shrink.``; else push ``Suggestion: the largest contributor is the `${label}` message (role: `${role}`); no Mulligan operation applies to a non-tool message.``. Keep the `if (rows.length > 0)` guard. A ternary assigned to `const suggestion` then a single `lines.push(suggestion)` is the cleanest shape. Update the preceding comment to note the role-aware branching (BUG-008). Leave the empty-filtered early-return (~line 455–459), the blank-separator `lines.push("")` (~line 472), and the final `return lines.join("\n") + "\n";` (line 481) UNCHANGED.

Task 2 — In test/tools/audit.test.ts, add a NEW `describe("renderAuditReport — role-aware Suggestion (BUG-008)")` block (place it right after the existing `(l) renderAuditReport — pure unit cases` block). Build a shared `base` args object (totalTokens:100, confidence:"medium", rewinds:[], shrinks:[], checkpointNames:[], protectedRoles:[], filtered:[{role:"user",content:"hi"}] — non-empty so the Suggestion is reached) and a `row(role, label): AuditRow` helper. Add at least 5 `it` cases: (1) role "toolResult" → report contains `the \`<label>\` result is the largest contributor.` AND `Consider mulligan_shrink.` AND NOT `the assistant turn` AND NOT `no Mulligan operation applies`; (2) role "assistant" → contains `the assistant turn \`<label>\` is the largest contributor.` AND `Consider mulligan_rewind (last_tool_call_group) or mulligan_shrink.` AND NOT `result is the largest contributor.`; (3) role "user" → contains `the largest contributor is the` AND `message (role: \`user\`)` AND `no Mulligan operation applies to a non-tool message.`; (4) role "custom" (otherwise) → contains `no Mulligan operation applies to a non-tool message.` AND `role: \`custom\``; (5) regression: `rows: [], filtered: []` → contains `No messages in filtered view.` AND NOT `Suggestion:`. `renderAuditReport` and `type AuditRow` are already imported — confirm and do not re-import.

Task 3 (optional but recommended) — Add ONE end-to-end tool test proving the real message role flows through to the Suggestion: seed `runtime(ctx.sessionManager).lastFiltered = [user("hi"), asstWithContent({ type:"text", text: "y".repeat(20000) })]` (the long assistant text makes it the largest via estimateTokens' monotonicity), run the tool, and assert `firstText(res)` contains `the assistant turn` and `Consider mulligan_rewind (last_tool_call_group) or mulligan_shrink.`. If token-ranking does not place the assistant at rows[0] in the run environment, drop this case — the pure-renderer tests in Task 2 are deterministic and authoritative.

Run validation: `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` then `npx vitest run test/tools/audit.test.ts` then `npm test`. Confirm: 0 type errors; audit.test.ts fully green (the 5+ new cases pass; the 4 existing Suggestion assertion sites at lines 190–191, 277, 287–288, 557 still pass because the toolResult path is byte-identical and the empty-view omission is unchanged); the full suite green (697+ passed, 2 skipped, 0 newly broken). If any OTHER pre-existing test fails, it is unrelated to this change — investigate but do NOT widen the edit beyond the renderAuditReport Suggestion block + the new audit.test.ts cases.

successCriteria.description: src/tools/audit.ts renderAuditReport: the Suggestion block branches on rows[0].role into exactly three cases — toolResult (byte-identical to the current hard-coded line), assistant, and otherwise (user/custom/unknown) — emitting the three contract strings verbatim.

The toolResult branch emits `Suggestion: the \`<label>\` result is the largest contributor. Consider mulligan_shrink.` byte-for-byte (so existing assertions toContain("Consider mulligan_shrink.") at audit.test.ts lines 190–191 and 287–288 still pass).
The assistant branch emits `Suggestion: the assistant turn \`<label>\` is the largest contributor. Consider mulligan_rewind (last_tool_call_group) or mulligan_shrink.`
The otherwise branch emits `Suggestion: the largest contributor is the \`<label>\` message (role: \`<role>\`); no Mulligan operation applies to a non-tool message.`
The empty-filtered-view early-return is unchanged — when filtered is empty/absent the report renders `No messages in filtered view.` and contains NO `Suggestion:` line.
The final `return lines.join("\n") + "\n";` and the blank-separator `lines.push("")` before the Suggestion are unchanged (trailing newline behavior identical).
renderAuditReport still NEVER throws (pure string interpolation; covered by auditExecute's existing never-throws try/catch — no new try/catch added).
